reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about microstructural refinement, diffusion barrier behavior, and corrosion mechanisms in TiB2-reinforced boride coatings, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific behavior of laser-remelted TiB2 coatings in molten aluminum, so the lack of cited support leaves all key premises ungrounded.
premises: Laser remelting refines TiB2-reinforced boride coatings to a nanocrystalline structure
